Bring in the flyer, or order online through the MOD app or website, use the fundraiser code provided and MOD Pizza will donate 20% of your to support your Hawks View PAC! 

  • Date:  September 17, 2025
  • Address:  21370 SW Langer Farms Pkwy, Suite 132 / Sherwood
  • Fundraiser Code:  MODGIVES20
